Ethan (Sales): Heads-up — GlobalRetail wants a guaranteed capacity bump for their POC. Request: +3 GPUs on dp-77 during a prime demo block (2024-07-05 14:00 -> 2024-07-06 14:00 UTC). They also want scoped API keys for their on-call and a written note that capacity is guaranteed. Can infra + security confirm?
Rina (Solutions): Quick checks: which model, concurrency, and any external egress?
Lee (Client-SRE): We'll run rw-llama-13b-quant, ~220 concurrent, avg seq ~512. No external egress for the demo.
Jon (EngInfra): We can create a reservation (hard cap) rather than a burst so it's guaranteed. API example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/dp-77/reservations -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_TOKEN" -d '{"reservation_name":"gr-poc-20240705","gpus":3,"start_time":"2024-07-05T14:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-07-06T14:00:00Z","hard_cap":true}'
Nia (Security): For keys: scoped service account with IP allowlist and TTL. We'll require creation to be logged in the temporary access register and an audit ticket. No admin scopes.
Ethan (Sales): Can Finance give a ballpark so I can tell the client?
Finance Bot: Estimate: 3 GPUs * 24h = 72 GPU-hrs * $4.75 = $342. We can apply a $350 promotional waiver for the POC. Any overage invoiced after the event.
Jon (EngInfra): Deploying reservation now. We'll annotate the pool and mark it non-preemptible for the window. If they want business-hours-only, we can split into two smaller reservations but contiguous is simpler.
Deploy Bot: Reservation job queued: rb-20240621-342. Validating capacity.
Deploy Bot: Reservation applied ✅ reservation-id rv-gr-20240705-01. Scoped key created: gr-poc-sre-2024-07-05 (expires 2024-07-07T14:00:00Z). Audit ticket AT-592 opened.
Lee (Client-SRE): Key accepted. Ran smoke at ~200 conn: p50 180ms p95 520ms. Some p95 spikes from long responses; tuning batching helps.
Rina (Solutions): Recommend a fallback route to rw-llama-6b-quant for non-critical jobs to protect latency if traffic spikes.
Nia (Security): Post-demo checklist: revoke keys, capture audit logs, confirm deletion of exported telemetry, update temporary access register. Approval pending those controls.
Ethan (Sales): I'll email GlobalRetail with reservation details, waiver confirmation, and security checklist. Please send confirmation when keys are revoked.
Lee (Client-SRE): Acknowledged, thanks team :rocket:
